description: A template formatter applied with `|`: `{{ value | pipeName: arg1 : arg2 }}`.
Interface with `transform(value, ...args)`, implemented by custom pipes.
The default. Re-runs only when the input reference or an argument changes.
`pure: false`; runs on every change detection of the view (e.g. `async`). Use sparingly.
Injection token that controls locale-aware formatting; defaults to `en-US`.
